faq.a: Yes. BIZHAUS websites and Missed-Call Rescue use automated software, including artificial intelligence, to do routine work — like sending a quick text when you miss a call. The automation only answers from business information you approve (hours, area, prices). Anything else goes straight to you. You decide what it sends, and you can take over any conversation at any time.
No. Missed-Call Rescue sends one text per missed call, and only within 12 hours of the last one. No marketing follow-ups, ever.

mcr.headline: Missed-Call Rescue
steps: Your customer calls. You're on a ladder, under a sink, or with another client.
Within seconds, they get a text from your business — with your name and a booking link.
They book. You see it all in your dashboard. Nothing falls through the cracks.
mcr.text: When you can't pick up, your business still answers.
